title: Balanced Brackets
statement:
A string made of `(` `)` `[` `]` `{` `}` is *balanced* if every opening bracket is closed by the same kind of bracket, in the right order.
For example `([]{})` is balanced, `([)]` is not.

## Input
One line with the string `s`.

## Output
Print `YES` if `s` is balanced, otherwise `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
